Questions

Before you switch

How do I bring my iCloud Drive files over?

+

Download them to the computer running Uncloud. On a Mac, turn off Optimize Mac Storage for iCloud Drive; on other computers, download from iCloud.com. Then choose Add files in Uncloud and select the folder.

Does Uncloud replace iPhone backups or iCloud Photos?

+

No. Uncloud stores files. iPhone backups, iCloud Photos and iCloud Mail remain separate.

Does everyone get their own space?

+

Yes. Each person gets their own account and private files. Unlimited household members and devices are included.

Can I open my files on my iPhone?

+

Yes. Sign in from Safari or any browser to reach your Uncloud files at home or away.

What does Uncloud cost?

+

Join early access to lock in $79 at launch ($99 regular), paid once. Household members, devices, remote access, file migration and updates are included. No payment today; try it free for 30 days when you get access.
